label: Dei Filius attributes: the classical attributes defined as nineteen typed or primitive conjuncts
definition: CLASSICAL_FIELD_2. DeiFiliusAttributes σ InAct GoodIn InPotency CausesIn esse MoreIn ComponentOf Composite MatterForm Infinite Eternal HasIntellect HasWill P D g holds when g has every attribute that Vatican I, Dei Filius ch. 1 (DS 3001, with goodness from DS 3002) confesses of God, in the following typed reading, each a typed predicate or an explicitly identified primitive: one (IsTheOneGod σ.IsGod, DEF-ONE-GOD); living (primitive Lives, LIVING_1); creator of heaven and earth (IsCreatorOfAll: g causes the being of everything else in act as to being; contained by definition in the goodness field); lord (primitive IsLord); almighty (IsAlmighty: g can do every consistent task, in the Power vocabulary DEF-ACTIVE-POWER-TASK-VOCABULARY); eternal (ETERNAL_1); immense (primitive Immense); incomprehensible (primitive Incomprehensible); infinite in intellect, will and every perfection, read as HasIntellect, HasWill, IsPerfect and Infinite (HAS_INTELLECT_1, HAS_WILL_1, PERFECT_2, INFINITE_1); altogether simple (IsSimple, SIMPLE_4); unchangeable (IsImmutable, IMMUTABLE_1); spiritual (IsSpiritual: not composed of matter and form); really and essentially distinct from the world, given a DIFFERENT reading (RemoteFromAll, DEF-REMOTE-FROM-ALL); most blessed (primitive MostBlessed); exalted above all (IsMaximumIn InAct MoreIn esse, DEF-MAXIME-ENS); good (IsSupremelyGood, DEF-SUPREMELY-GOOD, a strengthening). The nine stage-two predicates are among the fields (nineOfDeiFilius).
note: Analyst reading of the attribute list recorded in claim VATICAN-I-DEI-FILIUS-CH1-ONE-TRUE-LIVING-GOD; the claim motivates the list and states no bridge. Phrases such as 'every Dei Filius attribute' in the batch mean every field of this typed reading. WEAKENINGS: 'creator' omits creation from nothing, freedom and a beginning; 'infinite in intellect and will' is read as the conjunction of having intellect, having will and being infinite (the infinity of intellect and will as such is not typed); 'substance' is not typed, only immateriality, which prime matter or an accident also satisfy; 'exalted above all' is read as not exceeded in being, not as exceeding everything else, and 'ineffably' and 'above all that can be conceived' are not typed. STRENGTHENING: 'good' is IsSupremelyGood, which includes causing every perfection of everything else (q.6 a.2), more than DS 3002's 'bonitate sua', which names God's goodness as the motive of creation; this is why 'creator' follows from it by definition. DIFFERENT READING: 'really and essentially distinct from the world' is RemoteFromAll (entering into the composition of nothing); the two are incomparable. The anti-pantheist content of DS 3001 and canons DS 3023-3024 (numerical non-identity with the world as a whole, distinctness in essence) is untyped, since the signature has no world term, and a Spinozist God, which is no part, matter or form of its modes, satisfies RemoteFromAll. 'True' (verus) is not a field: it is the predicate σ.IsGod (GOD_4) of which the attributes are confessed. 'Almighty' is active power and 'unchangeable' is the absence of passive potency (InPotency, DISAMB-POTENCY), so both hold without a sense clash. This defines CLASSICAL_FIELD_2, one reading of the primitive skeleton field HasClassicalAttributes, which stays undefined (DISAMB classical-attributes field content); FieldFromDeiFilius is the open one-way field interpretation on this reading. Five conjuncts are primitives with stated meanings and open bridges (see the Primitives structure).
